name: iMessage — the bug (vertical)
description: Vertical (TikTok/Reels) reflow of the live iOS Messages conversation — the thread widens to the vertical safe-area while the choreography holds. Over ~6s: a gray received bubble pops in, a three-dot typing indicator appears and resolves into the next bubble, a heart tapback pops onto it, then a blue sent reply arrives with a Delivered → Read receipt, and it holds. Chromeless (chrome: 'none', ADR-0037): just the gray (left) / blue (right) bubbles with tail curls floating over footage — no page, no header, no composer bar, film-insert style. Fully bare BY DESIGN (faithful-OS-artifact stance): no mono thread, no collage chrome; tail curls cut to genuine transparency; NO CSS glow on the captured DOM. Transparent WebM overlay, composited over footage.

messages.text: the bottleneck was a console.log inside a hot loop
